title: Red panda waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='78' rx='18' ry='9' fill='#c8552e' transform='rotate(-25 30 78)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='80' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#8a3a1e' transform='rotate(-25 24 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='74' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#8a3a1e' transform='rotate(-25 34 74)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='72' rx='22' ry='19' fill='#d9642f'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='76' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#f6e3cf'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='88' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5c2a18'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='88' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5c2a18'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M68 64 Q84 56 82 36' stroke='#d9642f' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='33' r='6.5' fill='#5c2a18'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='33' r='3' fill='#b06a45'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M34 68 Q26 74 26 82' stroke='#d9642f' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='9' fill='#d9642f'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='4.5' fill='#f6e3cf'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='9' fill='#d9642f'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='4.5' fill='#f6e3cf'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='23' fill='#e8743a'/>
  <!-- face white markings -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#f6e3cf'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='34' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#f6e3cf'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='34' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#f6e3cf'/>
  <!-- tear stripes -->
  <path d='M33 34 Q36 44 40 50' stroke='#8a3a1e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 34 Q64 44 60 50' stroke='#8a3a1e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='4' fill='#2b1430'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='4' fill='#2b1430'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='34.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='34.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2b1430'/>
  <path d='M50 48 Q46 52 43 50 M50 48 Q54 52 57 50' stroke='#8a3a1e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
